svg.title: 1,000 custom notices in about 60 seconds
svg.desc: Detailed Gantt chart showing input preparation, client facts, page composition and QR codes, PDF export, content and page checks, saved originals, fingerprints, cache cleanup, protected copies and their checks, grouped PDFs and reports. Work repeats for each notice; encryption overlaps notice creation.

g.text: From CSV to checked, protected and grouped PDFs.
Work repeats for each person. Stronger blocks mean more work during that second.
Encryption overlaps notice creation. Approximate timeline rounded to 60 seconds.
